input_fields.name: target_window_state
input_fields.description: Unique SpaceClaim window identity and observed maximize/full-screen, dialog, viewport, tree, status-bar, and orientation-indicator state.

input_fields.name: review_object
input_fields.description: One model/object or review target whose visibility is being assessed.

result_fields.name: viewport_reviewability
result_fields.description: Maximized/unobstructed status, visible controls, target visibility, and any recorded obstruction.

procedure: Observe the active SpaceClaim window, viewport, Structure tree, status bar, orientation indicator, and blocking dialogs.
Record maximize/full-screen state and whether review_object is visible enough for this review.
Return viewport_reviewability with obstruction details; do not dismiss or rearrange panels.
If a blocking dialog or required exception exists, record it rather than claiming unobstructed review.
rejection_rules: Reject a nonunique session or a review target that cannot be identified.
Do not shrink/maximize the window inside this observation atom; EX-03 owns maximize.
Do not infer hidden geometry is absent.
